Martin Jr. (former ARS President), "Ten Principles of Rose Pruning", republished by Nashville Rose Society and Acadiana Rose Society; FRD code ARSTEN; web address <https://www.nashvillerosesociety.org/ten-principals-of-rose-pruning/>, accessed 29 September 2026.
